speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellowing of the eyes and skin. To determine the cause, how many weeks pregnant was your mother when you were born, and were you delivered via vaginal birth or C-section?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding-associated jaundice (physiologic jaundice exacerbated by low intake/malabsorption). 

REQUEST TEST: Total_Serum_Bilirubin, Direct_Bilirubin, Blood_Type_and_Rh_Coombs_Test.
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound (to rule out biliary atresia if direct bilirubin is elevated).
